prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / premium website product artwork.
Create a NEW high-resolution, clean MetaTrader 5 emblem for a website's right-hand product feature, using the reference ONLY for the recognizable brand composition (three interlocking green, yellow-gold and blue trader figures around the central numeral 5).
Replace the dated graphic styling with beautifully smooth molded satin ceramic / soft-touch enamel. Single sculptural emblem, front-facing with very subtle depth, precise rounded geometry and generous negative space. Green figure at top, gold at lower left, blue at lower right; a pristine warm-white circular disc in front with one crisp dark charcoal numeral "5". Recognizable MT5 identity, not a generic interlocking knot. Soft broad studio highlights, diffuse ambient occlusion, smooth clean silhouettes; restrained dimensionality, no chrome, no metallic reflections, no scratches, no glass fragments, no faceting, no jagged edges. Deep enough green and blue for contrast on a lime or sky-blue section background.
Only the emblem. No background panel, no blue square, no surrounding chart cards, no extra icons, no rings, no pedestal, no text apart from "5", no watermark. Large centered object filling approximately 78% of square canvas, all parts fully visible with 10% transparent margin. Genuine transparent alpha background. Aim for 2048 x 2048 pixel export or highest available resolution, tack-sharp edges with natural antialiasing. Balanced premium finish that remains clear at 300 to 600 CSS pixels.
encoding: Lossless WebP with original dimensions and alpha; no upscaling.
